verdicts.title: The closure of the symplectic cone of elliptic surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The symplectic cone of a closed oriented 4-manifold is the set of cohomology classes represented by symplectic forms. A well-known conjecture describes this cone for every minimal Kaehler surface. We consider the case of the elliptic surfaces E(n) and focus on a slightly weaker conjecture for the closure of the symplectic cone. verdicts.title: Translated points for contactomorphisms of prequantization spaces over monotone symplectic toric manifolds
